_comment: Installed to ~/.config/opencode/routines.json by provision-mac.sh. Titles, descriptions and hour windows for the app's Scheduled view; the schedule itself comes from the launchd plists. `window` mirrors the gate the script enforces itself, so the next-run time is honest.

dev.coval.pr-review-sweep.title: PR review sweep
dev.coval.pr-review-sweep.description: Reviews pull requests that ask for Callum's review, including re-reviews when a PR he already reviewed gets new commits. Posts the review as him; skips PRs he approved at their current head.

dev.coval.pr-review-queue.title: PR review queue
dev.coval.pr-review-queue.description: Hourly pass over the review queue: anything the sweep left, plus the queue state file.

dev.coval.pr-review-fixer.title: PR review auto-fixer
dev.coval.pr-review-fixer.description: Fixes bot review comments on Callum's open PRs and pushes the fix. Skips PRs labeled cow:no-autofix (the brain toggle in Pull requests).

dev.coval.pr-keep-updated.title: Keep PRs updated with base
dev.coval.pr-keep-updated.description: Updates Callum's open PR branches from their base every half hour; DMs once when one conflicts. Skips PRs labeled cow:no-update (the branch toggle in Pull requests).

dev.coval.daily-workers-health-audit.title: Daily workers health audit
dev.coval.daily-workers-health-audit.description: Morning audit of the evaluation worker fleets.

dev.bronson.cow-health.title: Box health check
dev.bronson.cow-health.description: Checks the box's services, tunnel and disk each morning and DMs the report on Slack.

dev.coval.pr-auto-merge.title: Merge when ready
dev.coval.pr-auto-merge.description: Every 10 minutes: for each of Callum's open PRs carrying the cow:merge label (the merge toggle in Pull requests), enable GitHub auto-merge (squash) once it is green, approved, conflict-free and has no unresolved comments; when the merge queue bounces it, an agent works out why, fixes the PR if the PR caused it, and re-queues, up to 3 times, then DMs.
